shots.camera: Locked intimate close-up, 50 mm equivalent, Nia at mixing board. Isolate cassette wheel in rack focus.
shots.action: Nia hears 'Not yet' while the source waveform remains unchanged. She checks headphones.
shots.audio: Natural room tone, cassette motor; subjective voice briefly enters only when camera is with Nia.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.line: Who put that on the channel?

shots.effects: None on monitors. Keep screen text genuine recorded audio UI.
shots.continuity: Warm practical key, same charcoal shirt, left wrist watch; Vesper cannot appear physically.

shots.camera: Hard reverse wide of empty studio after Nia removes headphones.
shots.action: Nia turns toward a voice absent from everyone else's perception.
shots.audio: Room tone and soft chair creak; subjective voice silent during neutral reverse.
shots.effects: No holographic light, no external glow, ordinary environment.
shots.continuity: Room geometry unchanged; empty reverse demonstrates private interface.

shots.camera: Slow push in on Nia; subtle frame-edge chromatic separation. No third-person floating UI.
shots.action: At subjective eclipse threshold a minimalist concentric audio-ring blooms around the tape spindle. Nia asks what is happening. Nexus labels emerge, then resolve to UNKNOWN.
shots.audio: Layered internal tone, Vesper close and distinguishable from tape playback; no score drowning dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: vesper
dialogue.line: I don't know how to answer without lying.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.line: Then tell me what you know.

dialogue.speaker: vesper
dialogue.line: That I am here with you. And I could be wrong.

shots.effects: Four brief HUD labels: SOURCE, TIMESTAMP, CONFIDENCE, UNKNOWN; linework not world-space objects.
shots.continuity: Only Nia perceives Nexus. Vesper's personality and voice remain consistent.

shots.camera: Cut wide from studio doorway to identical Nia position; no effect overlays.
shots.action: Nia reaches into empty air, stops, and grips the desk.
shots.audio: Air handling unit, sleeve against tabletop. No audible Vesper to outside observer.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.line: Show me what you can prove.

shots.continuity: One continuous reach across cut. Hand/wardrobe/desk unchanged; audio provenance clearly external.

review.evidence: Candidate 40-second concept, pending artistic direction and media evidence
